verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several natural-language interfaces. Ask AI answers plain-English questions about your inbox. Mail MCP lets you drive the inbox and calendar from Claude or ChatGPT with prompts to draft, send, schedule and run follow-ups. Plain-language prompts also shape writing, custom Auto Labels and chat-built agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the NL commands work as claimed, and clear evidence of native in-app NL execution of arbitrary actions beyond Q&A and drafting (most action-taking runs through external AI assistants via MCP).
